program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define proto (first (filter (lambda (obj) (= (obj-color obj) 3)) (objects g 0))))
    (define proto-crop (subgrid g (obj-r1 proto) (obj-c1 proto) (obj-r2 proto) (obj-c2 proto)))
    (define canvas
      (find-first
        (lambda (obj)
          (and (= (obj-color obj) 8)
               (= (obj-h obj) (rows proto-crop))
               (= (obj-w obj) (cols proto-crop))
               (= (obj-size obj) (* (obj-h obj) (obj-w obj)))))
        (objects g 0)))
    (for*/fold ([out g])
               ([r (in-range (rows proto-crop))]
                [c (in-range (cols proto-crop))])
      (set-cell out (+ (obj-r1 canvas) r) (+ (obj-c1 canvas) c)
                (if (= (at proto-crop r c) 3) 8 0)))))
